card: This pull request replaces the external Boost.Test framework across all unit tests with an in-tree runner and assertion framework located in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp}. Boost.Test introduces dependency complexity in depends and Guix and offers assertion macros that frequently omit evaluated operand values on test failures. Replacing Boost Test has been discussed across RFC #34666 and issue #8670, with related issues like signal stack sizes noted in #36045. Most file changes are mechanical include updates handled by a scripted diff, while backward-compatible BOOST_* macro wrappers are retained to avoid merge conflicts with open pull requests. Boost.Test is dropped from depends, CMake, Guix, and vcpkg.
changed_since_previous: Added commits to eliminate low-usage BOOST macros (BOOST_FAIL, BOOST_TEST_INFO), fix clang-tidy in miniminer_tests, and work around a GCC 12 uninitialized variable false positive in spend_tests.

enables: Subsequent migration of unit test files to native test framework macros (CHECK, REQUIRE, TEST_CASE).

evidence: Description notes Boost.Test removal simplifies depends and Guix and enables more effective use of IWYU and clang-tidy in test files.

Description demonstrates developer friction: macros like BOOST_CHECK(expr1 == expr2) print expressions without operand values, whereas the new framework automatically outputs decomposed operand values.
Longstanding interest and issues cited by author: RFC #34666 ('Replacing Boost Unit Test Framework?'), #8670 ('Replacing Boost Test Framework'), and signal stack issues in #36045.
problem: Boost.Test introduces external dependency maintenance overhead, requires build and packaging workarounds across Guix and depends, and suffers from inconsistent assertion macros that often fail to print operand values during test failures. It also prevents tighter integration with Bitcoin-specific logging, debugging output, and tooling.

risk.why: Flaws in the custom test framework runner or decomposed assertions could cause broken unit tests to pass silently in CI.

scope_notes: Adds an in-tree ~1,200-line test framework in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp}. Most of the 167 modified files are mechanical #include replacements performed via scripted-diff.
summary: Replaces Boost.Test with an in-tree C++ test runner and assertion framework in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp}. The new framework supports expression decomposition to automatically print evaluated operand values upon failure while providing backward-compatible BOOST_* macro shims for existing tests. Build systems and dependencies in CMake, depends, Guix, and vcpkg are updated to drop the Boost.Test library entirely.
